target_customer: Fast-growing companies running customer support on Zendesk, Intercom or Front
problem: Chatbots resolve only a minority of tickets (the launch post cites about 30 percent for Intercom bots), so support teams scale headcount with volume.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI support automation plus an agent-assist product (pricing not found)

founders.name: Ruoni Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page: full-stack engineer building AI and ML applications, patent author in natural language processing. Education not listed.

founders.name: Jeff Huang
founders.background_notes: YC page: former CTO at Lunaris Trading and arbitrage team lead at Akuna Capital.

founders.name: Victoria (Vickie) Wan
prior_employers: Pry Financials (YC W21, acquired by Brex)
founders.background_notes: YC page: strategic finance for startups and public companies, first marketing hire at Pry Financials.

competitors.name: Intercom
competitors.what: Support platform whose chatbot the YC launch post names as the incumbent, resolving about 30 percent of tickets; it also launched the GPT-4 based Fin bot in March 2023
competitors.traction_then: the launch post says its bots resolve only about 30 percent of tickets for OpenSight's targets

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval over help content plus action execution such as refunds needs integrations and reliability, but the LLM was an API. The launch post claims a proprietary relevancy algorithm.

defensibility.rationale: Support platforms with the data and distribution shipped LLM bots within weeks, and many startups chased the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Intercom announced Fin on March 14, 2023, during the batch window. No source documents what happened to OpenSight.

market_need_then: The launch post describes support teams scaling cost with ticket volume and shows a comparison of its answer bot against Stripe's help center and docs. LLM advances in late 2022 made higher resolution rates plausible.

branding.domain_note: Used opensight.ai. A trademark record for OPENSIGHT exists under another owner in Class 9, and other OpenSight products exist, including a YC W23 listing in a directory.

identity.voice_and_tone: Claim led: resolves more than 70 percent of inbound inquiries

brand_strength.rationale: A Product Hunt listing exists, but no press, community or merch was found and the name is shared by several unrelated products.

outcome_analysis: OpenSight entered the AI support automation market in the Winter 2023 batch just as Intercom shipped Fin and many startups launched similar bots, with a reported $500K YC sized pre-seed and no later round found. The YC directory lists it inactive but no shutdown notice, pivot or post-mortem was found and the website returned HTTP 503, so the cause is not public.
notes: The $500K pre-seed rests on a single database (VCBacked, repeated by Altss). Intercom's 30 percent figure is the founders' claim in the YC launch post. Website returned HTTP 503. Exit type unknown because YC status Inactive has no shutdown source.
